title: Business and Technical Evaluation Checklist
readerIntent: Evaluate whether Nodics fits a proposed product and operating model.
priorKnowledge: Know the product goals, expected users, integrations, and deployment constraints.
summary: Use this checklist to turn a product evaluation into verifiable business, architecture, security, operations, and adoption decisions.

sections.heading: Business fit
items: Which reusable Nodics capabilities replace custom foundation work?
Which requirements are project-specific and belong in customer modules?
Which claimed business solutions are already implemented?
What skills and operating responsibilities remain with the adopting organization?

sections.heading: Architecture and extension
items: Can each requirement be assigned to one authoritative capability?
Can customization use layering or a provider without modifying framework source?
Are tenant, enterprise, server, and node boundaries explicit?
Are APIs and data contracts sufficient for separate frontend applications?

sections.heading: Security and operations
items: Are human, service, and scheduled access paths separated?
Are authorization, tenant isolation, audit, rollback, and secret ownership documented?
Are health, logging, metrics, recovery, backup, and scaling responsibilities understood?
Do positive, rejected, boundary, integration, and regression tests provide evidence?
